# ScentWise

> ScentWise (https://scent-wise.com) is a web app that recommends perfumes with AI. It has a searchable database of about 69,000 fragrances, seven ways to ask for recommendations (chat, dupe finder, zodiac, photo, music, style and celebrity), and a library of fragrance guides. Browsing the database is free; the AI advisor gives one free answer, two more after an email, and a one-time $10 purchase unlocks it for good.

ScentWise is an independent site written and maintained by Kerem Toker. Recommendations are generated by Google Gemini and grounded in the site's own fragrance data (notes, accords, brand and concentration). Like any AI output they can be wrong; notes and prices should be checked against the retailer before buying. Shop links go to Amazon and other retailers through affiliate programs, which pay the site a commission at no cost to the buyer.

## Product

- [Home and AI advisor](https://scent-wise.com/): database search, the seven AI modes and celebrity collections
- [About](https://scent-wise.com/about.html): who runs the site, where the data comes from and how the AI is used
- [How the AI recommendations work](https://scent-wise.com/blog/ai-perfume-recommendations.html): what the advisor does well and where its limits are

## Facts

- Database: about 69,000 fragrances searchable in the browser; about 8,000 of them carry full note pyramids and accords
- Celebrity collections: 101 people, with the fragrances they are publicly associated with
- AI modes: chat advisor, dupe finder, zodiac match, photo style scan, music to fragrance, style match, celebrity explorer
- AI model: Google Gemini (gemini-3.5-flash, with fallback models)
- Pricing: database free; AI advisor 1 free answer, 2 more after sharing an email, then $10 one-time for lifetime access (500 AI queries per month)
- No account needed; works in any modern browser and can be installed as a PWA
- Cookies: analytics and advertising cookies load only after consent
- Launched: 2025
